Karakacaturthī_(vrata)
CPB. 676. TD. 14646. Puruṣārthacintāmaṇi, N. S. Press, edn. [Page171-a. (1906) p.. 94-95, says that it is the same a. Daśarathacaturthī.
--from Itihāsasamuccaya. Allahabad 57. Not found in the ptd. text of Itihāsasamuccaya. See Karakabhadrācaturthī below.

Karakaṇḍacariu
Jain. Pkt. See below Karakaṇḍa(ḍu)carita.

Karakaṇḍa(ṇḍu)carita
Jain. Apabhraṁśa. in 10 chs. by Kanakāmaramuni. CPB. 7068. Pannalal Bombay 92. Pannalal Bombay I. p. 45. H. L. Jain's edn. noted below uses 3 more mss., 2 from Jaipur an. one secured by him privately.
Ed.. H. L. Jain with Eng. transl., Intro. an. word-index, Kāranja Jain Ser. 4, Kārañja, Berar, 1934; revised edn. with additional Hindi transl. Bhāratīya Jnānapīṭha, Apabhraṁśa Texts 4, 1964. See also Allahabad Uni. Studies I. p. 174.

Karakaṇḍacaritra
Jain. Skt. Malakheda 26.

Karakaṇḍucarita
Jain. Apabhraṁśa. by Rayadhū of the 15th Cent. A. D. See Jaina Sid. Bhās. X. ii. p. 57.

Karakaṇḍucarita
Jain. by Śrīdatta Paṇḍita. See N. Premi, Digambar Jain Granthakartā aur unke Granth (Intro. p. 33 fn. 3 of H. L. Jain's edn. of Karakaṇḍacarita).

Karakaṇḍucaritra
Jain. Pkt. in 4 chs. by Jinendrabhūṣaṇa Bhaṭṭāraka, son of Brahmaharṣasāgara, successor of Viśvabhūṣaṇa Bhaṭṭāraka; part of Jinendrapurāṇa by the a.; written C. 1676 A. D. BORI. 1407 of 1886-92. P. XXI. 1407. Peters. IV. p. 53 (no. 1407). Strassburg Dig. p. 4 (ºkathā or ºupākhyāna).

Karakaṇḍūcaritra
Jain. Skt. version of Kanakāmara's Apabhraṁśa work, written in 1555 A. D. by Śubhacandra, helped by [Page171-b] Sakalabhūṣaṇa. CPB. 7067. Jhalrapatan p. 21 (inc.). Pannalal Bombay 97.

Karakadāna
dh. for saubhāgya. TD. 13769.

Karaka(rka)bhadrācaturthīvrata
for saubhāgya. assigned to Vāmanapurāṇa. Ben. 53 (inc.). RASB. V. 3991. SB. 247. Not found in the Veṅk. Press edn. of V. Purāṇa.
Pt.. a. from Vāmanapurāṇa with Hindi C. from Veṅk. Press, Bombay, 1915. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1252.

Karakāmeṣṭiprayoga

Karaku(ka)ṇḍakathā

Karaṅkiṇītantra
tantra. Q. in Śivānanda's Siṁhasiddhāntasindhu, Ujjain ms. no. 6497.

Karaṅkiṇīmata

--Yakṣiṇīkalpa(-prayoga) from. BBRAS. 865. RASB. VIII. A. 6028. C.. below K. Mahā (Meru) tantra.

Karaṅkiṇīmahā(meru)tantra
mentioned a. beg., a. one of the sources in the Mantrakhaṇḍa of Rasaratnākara of Nityanātha, Bomb. Uni. 224. IO. 2616. In the ptd. edn. of Rasaratnākara (Rasagranthamālā, Gondal, 1926) variant given a. Kiṅkiṇīmerutantra. See above Karaṅkiṅītantra an. Karaṅkiṇīmatatantra.

Karaṭikautuka

Karaṇakamalamārtaṇḍa
jy. d. 1058. A. D. written under King Bhoja of Dhāra with whose Rājamṛgāṅka it has some connection; by Daśabala.

Karpūramañjarī
Pkt. play of the type called Saṭṭaka; in 4 Acts called Yavanikāntaras; staged a. the instance of a.'s wife Avantisundarī. by Rājaśekhara. The name ‘Rajanīvallabha’ found in some mss. refers only to Rājaśekhara, based a. it is on the word ‘Rajanī vallabhaśikhaṇḍa’ in I. 5. The a. name found in a no. of mss. in BORI. a. ‘Vācanācārya’ is a hang-over from mss. of the play with C. by Dharmacandragaṇi who is found in cols. a. Vācanācārya.

or ºsaGgraha also called prayogamukha(maNDana), prayoga(-viveka-)saGgraha an. vArarucasaGgraha a popular manual in 26 anuṣṭubh verses on Skt. syntax an. wordformation, ascribed to Vararuci; sometimes divided into three sections (Cakras or Paṭalas), dealing with Kāraka, Samāsa, Taddhita an. Kṛdanta. For mss. of the Samāsa portion alone, which are found in plenty, see under Samāsacakra. The name Kārakacakra applies strictly to the first part of the work, but is used for the whole work also. See also under Prayoga(viveka)saṅgraha etc. In some mss. the name Pra. mukha is applied to the C.
The Prayogaviveka of Subrahmaṇya Dīkṣita in Tamil is a metrical transl. of this Skt. work.
